text: Transportation Services is recommending the designation of a commercial loading zone to operate at all times on the north side of Collier Street 20 metres east of Yonge Street. The proposed commercial loading zone will help facilitate operations for businesses on Collier Street and Yonge Street.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of the commercial loading zone on Collier Street, as generally described in Attachment 1 to the report (August 23, 2021) from the General Manager, Transportation Services.
